steps.sh: echo "--- tmux"; tmux -L unsent-072 display -p -t $SESS "alt=#{alternate_on} dead=#{pane_dead}";echo "--- ps"; ps -o pid,ppid,stat,command -ax | grep -E "bin/agy|bin/unsent" | grep -v grep;echo "--- open under the scratch home"; P=$(pgrep -f "$RIG/bin/agy" | head -1); lsof -p "$P" 2>/dev/null | grep -F "/Volumes/Data/unsent-072.VIQD/home-profile" | awk '{print $4, $NF}' | sed "s|$RIG|RIG|";echo "--- conversations"; ls -la "/Volumes/Data/unsent-072.VIQD/home-profile/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations" 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2;echo "--- history.jsonl"; cat "/Volumes/Data/unsent-072.VIQD/home-profile/.gemini/antigravity-cli/history.jsonl" 2>/dev/null;echo "--- unsent drafts"; ls -la "/Volumes/Data/unsent-072.VIQD/unsent-home2/drafts" 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2;echo "--- unsent records"; for f in "/Volumes/Data/unsent-072.VIQD/unsent-home2"/drafts/*.json "/Volumes/Data/unsent-072.VIQD/unsent-home2"/history/*.json; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; echo "$f:"; cat "$f"; echo; done | sed "s|$RIG|RIG|g";echo "--- unsent sent logs"; for f in "/Volumes/Data/unsent-072.VIQD/unsent-home2"/sent/*; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; echo "$f:"; cat "$f"; done | sed "s|$RIG|RIG|g";
